Blueshyft and Bitcoin Australia partner to sell bitcoin over the counter at 1,200 newsagency shops

Access to bitcoin in Australia became far easier today, as a Melbourne-based startup, Bitcoin Australia, teamed up with one of the largest retail networks in Australia, Blueshyft.
